description_en: Converts the billing method of cloud desktops to subscription or pay-as-you-go
description_zh: 将云电脑的付费类型转为包年包月或按量付费
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-charge-type --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopChargeType

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The target billing method to which you want to convert
parameters.help_zh: 要转换的目标计费方式
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the cloud desktop when you convert the billing method to subscription. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit. This parameter takes effect and is required only when ChargeType is set to PrePaid.

If PeriodUnit is set to Week, the valid value of this parameter is 1.
If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values of this parameter are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values of this parameter are 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5
parameters.help_zh:
转换成包年包月计费方式时，云电脑的购买时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。当参数`ChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。

如果`PeriodUnit`为`Week`，该参数的取值范围为1。
如果`PeriodUnit`为`Month`，该参数的取值范围为1、2、3、6。
如果`PeriodUnit`为`Year`，该参数的取值范围为1、2、3、4、5
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration when you convert the billing method to subscription
parameters.help_zh: 转换成包年包月计费方式时，包年包月计费的时长单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically pay for the order when you convert the billing method to subscription
parameters.help_zh: 转换成包年包月计费方式时，是否自动支付订单费用
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 20 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 处于定向邀测中，暂不对外开放
parameters.name: use_duration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource ownership user in reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not using reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid

DesktopId.description_en: The cloud desktop IDs. If multiple cloud desktops are created in a single call, multiple cloud desktop IDs are returned
DesktopId.description_zh: 云电脑ID列表。如果一次调用创建了多个云电脑，将返回多个云电脑ID
